description: This file defines the interface 'CohortDAO' which specifies database operations for 'Cohort' objects in the OpenMRS project. It includes methods for CRUD operations, retrieval by various parameters, and managing cohort memberships.

classes.name: CohortDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations related to Cohort objects in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort by its primary key (ID).

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort by its name.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Returns all Cohorts, with the option to include voided ones.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatientId
methods.description: Finds all cohorts that include a specific patient ID, optionally filtering by date and voided status.

methods.name: saveCohort
methods.description: Saves or updates a Cohort object in the database.

methods.name: getCohorts
methods.description: Finds cohorts with names matching a fragment.

methods.name: deleteCohort
methods.description: Deletes a given Cohort from the database.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Cohort by its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a CohortMembership by its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves cohort memberships for a patient, optionally active on a specific date, including or excluding voided.
